Conte's Sunday Ride p/b B2C2

Lexington, MA · Road

Beginner friendly

Conte's Sunday Ride p/b B2C2 is a road group ride in Lexington, MA. It rolls every Sunday at 9:00 am from Conte's Bike Shop. About 35–47.5 depending on group miles, s >24 mph / A 20–22 / B 18–20 / C 16–17 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 24 mph: fast — for riders who race or train. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Conte's Sunday Ride p/b B2C2 group ride

One ride, four groups. The S group is a team time trial that drops; A and B are no-drop within their pace; C is strictly no-drop and meant for people new to group riding. Riders from the south can join the team rolling from the Uncle Sam statue in Arlington at 8:30. Coffee at the shop after.
